selected_script.angle: Desk Edge Cable Drop Pain Relief
selected_script.hook: Tired of diving under your desk every time your charger slides off?

video_001_part_01.visual: 0-3s: Handheld shot of a phone charging cable sliding off a clean wooden desk edge, followed by a hand searching blindly under the desk. 3-6s: A Peach/Orange squarish magnetic cable clip is stuck on the clean desk edge. A hand flips the hinged clear cover tab upward along the rear hinge, lays the cable flat horizontally in the open channel, and releases it to let the magnet snap shut. 6-10s: The cable stays perfectly in place at the desk edge.
video_001_part_01.audio: Tired of diving under your desk every time your charger slides off? Fix it instantly with this magnetic clip.

video_001_part_02.visual: 0-4s: A bedside nightstand showing a phone charger neatly secured in a matching Peach/Orange magnetic clip. 4-8s: A car dashboard center console where a media cable is held tidily. 8-10s: Screen text overlay reading 'Keep your space organized.' on a clean desk workspace setup.
video_001_part_02.audio: Works on your desk, nightstand, or car. Keep your space organized.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s show a close-up of a messy desk edge where a black USB-C cable slides off and drops to the floor, leaving a frustrated hand reaching down. 3-6s: Transition to a clean wooden desk edge. A Peach/Orange squarish cable organizer clip with a clear cover is mounted. A hand lifts the clear magnetic cover tab upward along the rear hinge, lays the cable flat horizontally into the 7.55mm groove, and lets the magnetic cover snap shut. 6-10s: Show the first clean result with the cable held securely at the desk edge. No CTA. Keep product color Peach/Orange, clear top cover, and squarish cube shape constant.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style continuation video, realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-4s: Show a close-up fast-cut scene on a bedside nightstand surface with a Peach/Orange magnetic clip holding a charging cable securely. 4-8s: Fast-cut to a car dashboard center console, where another Peach/Orange clip keeps a media cord neat. 8-10s: Short CTA with text overlay 'Keep your space organized.' against a clean workspace setup. Preserve identical product identity, color, shape, and material from the first segment.
